author: editorial-team
document_description: The document viewer appears immediately after the headline and metadata so the source record remains the focus of the page.
seo_description: A document-first PDF record template for static publishing.
editor_notes: Sample content reviewed for starter validation. Replace or remove before launch.
document_accessible_summary: This one-page demonstration record shows a simple meeting document layout. The sample contains a title, a short explanatory paragraph, and neutral placeholder content used only to prove the PDF viewer, direct-open link, download option, and static publication workflow.
document_accessibility_note: The HTML summary is provided so readers can understand the purpose and essential context without relying on the embedded PDF viewer.
series_description: A three-part demonstration of reporting, context, and primary-source publishing in TAHAI Press.
methodology: The PDF-first record demonstrates a source-centered page with file metadata, an accessible HTML summary, direct access, and permanent citation information.
disclosure: The attached PDF is a generated fixture for testing the publication workflow.
rights_and_reuse: Publishers are responsible for the rights status of source documents they upload.
what_changed: Added public-record classification, series context, and a correction-history example.
